_comment: Single source of truth for version pins, ports, paths, and defaults shared across the npm and Docker install paths. Read by scripts/dev-safe.mjs, scripts/dev-with-automation.mjs, docker/entrypoint.sh (via generated defaults.env), and .github/workflows/docker.yml.

sources._comment: Optional agent-server source for the npm and desktop launchers (scripts/launcher-defaults.mjs; Docker ignores it), so a build can run a fork of the SDK without environment variables. Fallbacks for OH_AGENT_SERVER_GIT_REPO (an https:// or ssh:// URL) and OH_AGENT_SERVER_GIT_REF: environment variables still win, and the ref applies only when the environment names no agent-server source. A full 40-hex commit is installed once and then reused offline; any other ref is refetched on every launch. null means unset: the agent-server comes from PyPI at versions.agentServer. Everything in this file is also compiled into the frontend bundle, so it must never hold a secret.

ports._vscodeComment: Port the bundled editor binds to inside the container; agent-server's own default. Only the Docker entrypoint reads this — the npm launchers derive the editor port from the agent-server port so several stacks can run side by side. It is never published: the editor is reached through paths.vscodeBasePath on the proxy port.

paths._vscodeBasePathComment: Path prefix the bundled editor is served under, on the same origin as the canvas. Passed to agent-server as OH_VSCODE_BASE_PATH (it launches openvscode-server with --server-base-path and advertises the prefix in /api/vscode/url), and registered as an ingress route to the VSCode port. Keeping one value on both sides is what lets a single-origin deployment reach the editor without publishing a second port. Tradeoff: a path prefix routes but does not isolate, so the editor shares the canvas's browser origin and therefore its localStorage — see docs/SELF_HOSTING.md and OpenHands/OpenHands#16492.
paths._stateDirComment: npm and desktop launchers only; Docker uses stateSubdir. The fallback for OH_CANVAS_SAFE_STATE_DIR: an absolute path or one starting with ~/. When set here, the session and secret key files (api-key.txt, secret-key.txt) live in it too. The parent of this directory is the agent-server's persistence root (settings, secrets, profiles, installed Apps, skills, the automation database), so a build that keeps its own state names a directory whose parent is its own, e.g. ~/.example-app/agent-canvas. null means ~/.openhands/agent-canvas.

setup._comment: Optional command the full-stack npm and desktop launchers (scripts/dev-with-automation.mjs: the desktop app, npm run dev, the agent-canvas bin) run as the user on every launch that starts the agent-server: before-start runs before any service starts; after-ready runs once the agent-server answers /server_info, with AGENT_SERVER_URL and SESSION_API_KEY in its environment, before automation, the frontend and the ingress start. An argv array run without a shell, stdin closed, working directory the state directory, OH_CANVAS_SETUP_PHASE naming the phase; its output goes to the startup log. A non-zero exit, a signal or 15 minutes without exiting stops the launch. null means no setup. phases lists before-start, after-ready or both (the default).
